headline: Step 21 Assumptions De-Risk Framework: 4 experiments designed to validate brand fidelity, 10-min provisioning, $24K WTP, warm-intro conversion
highlights: ✅ Experiment A1 (Brand Fidelity): Blind evaluation framework for 50 domains vs. SwagUp baseline; target ≥8.0/10, ≥70% win rate; 7-day execution
✅ Experiment A2 (10-Minute Provisioning): End-to-end latency tracking for 10 Step-9 prospects; target ≤8 min median, ≥80% SLA pass; 3-day execution; bottleneck identification built-in
✅ Experiment A3 ($24K WTP): Pricing acceptance survey across 10–15 People Ops professionals; target ≥60% acceptance, <20% hard rejection; 5-day execution; contingency Essentials tier at $12K
✅ Experiment A4 (Warm-Intro Conversion ABM): Founder-led outreach to 10 named prospects; target ≥2 pilots, ≥40% open rate, ≥30% reply, ≥15% demo request; 14-day execution; objection log built-in
📊 Supabase `experiments` table schema designed with JSONB result logging, RLS policies, audit trail, and sample data inserts (all 4 experiments pre-populated with realistic results)
🎯 Interactive Experiments Dashboard page (`/experiments`) built with real-time status tracking, per-experiment deep dives, conversion funnel visualization, and decision gate indicators
📋 Execution Playbook: Day-by-day operational guide with owner assignments, success metrics, contingency workflows, objection handling, and aggregate decision tree (GREEN/YELLOW/RED lights)
🔄 Pass/Fail Decision Tree: Explicit go/no-go criteria for Step 22 (MVBP Scale) and Step 23 (Pilot Onboarding); conditional paths for 3/4 PASS, 2/4 PASS scenarios with specific iteration roadmaps

⚡ Zero external cost model: All 4 experiments leverage internal MVBP, community goodwill, founder time; no paid incentives except $25 gift cards for A1 evaluators (stretch: could use platform credits instead)

📈 Integration with existing codebase: Landing page, command console, Supabase schema; experiments page uses Recharts for real-time funnel/status visualization; no breaking changes to existing architecture
